data.hypothesis: The selected scalar parent measured 0.45303 s. A guarded SIMD candidate without a width clause measured 0.08088 s, while the recorded simdlen(4) candidate measured 0.14358 s. This candidate tests whether an eight-lane OpenMP SIMD hint changes lowering favorably. It retains a zero-based contiguous x loop from row bases that include x0, uses no alignment clause or ISA assumption, and keeps the same compiler-vectorizable loop when the OpenMP SIMD guard is unavailable. Performance remains to be measured.

memory_lessons.applicability: OpenMP SIMD width-hint experiments for this stencil and frozen build.
memory_lessons.claim: The recorded simdlen(4) candidate measured 0.14358 s and the candidate removing that width clause measured 0.08088 s. This indicates a width hint can affect the measured result, but does not predict the effect of simdlen(8).
memory_lessons.next_experiment: Measure the guarded simdlen(8) candidate under the same official settings and compare it with the width-unspecified SIMD candidate.

data.notes: This candidate is based on selected parent 626f53210ff1412f at base commit d6333449dc6cd4d1bbf59a73329ee094d4bcfd84. No candidate correctness or timing result is available yet; the controller should validate and measure it. No alignment is asserted because x0 is included in each row start.
transformations: Keep the timestep kernel unfused and preserve its existing spatial bounds, arithmetic grouping, buffer parity, and interface.
Form each row pointer at the interior start x0 and traverse with a zero-based x index for width x1 - x0, applying the interior offset once.
Guard an explicit OpenMP simdlen(8) directive for OpenMP 4.0 or later; the same canonical loop remains available for compiler vectorization when the guard is absent.
Use no aligned clause because the actual line starts include the interior offset and alignment is not guaranteed.
Do not change compiler flags, threading, or spatial or temporal blocking.
